acceptance_criteria: Any failed effect must block state commit, preserve prior authoritative state (or explicit reconcile), and return blocked with a stable code—never advanced/terminal.

acceptance_criteria: Mutating operations without effectExecutor fail closed; only non-mutating status may omit it; regression tests cover denial and no commit.

summary: K2 scope-guard module bans can be bypassed via string concatenation
